title: Fix screen flickering or white screen on AMDGPU
summary: Resolve screen flickering or white/gray screen when changing resolution or connecting external monitors by disabling SG display.

steps.explain: Add the kernel parameter amdgpu.sg_display=0 to disable SG display.
steps.gui: Edit your bootloader configuration (e.g., GRUB) to add 'amdgpu.sg_display=0' to the kernel command line.

rollback.explain: Remove the kernel parameter from the bootloader configuration.
rollback.gui: Edit your bootloader configuration to remove 'amdgpu.sg_display=0'.

warnings: Requires editing bootloader configuration and rebooting.
